report.incident_summary: At 14:12 on 2026-01-15, conveyor 2 generated a MOTOR_TEMP_HIGH alarm indicating motor temperature of 69.06 °C. All other sensor readings (cooling flow ~11.9 L/min, motor current 7.89 A, conveyor speed 1.19 m/s, vibration 1.047 mm/s) remained within normal baseline ranges. No shutdown, speed reduction, or flow reduction was observed before or after the alarm.
report.leading_hypothesis: The high temperature alarm was likely caused by a temperature sensor fault producing a sudden unrealistic temperature jump.

timeline.observation: Motor temperature alarm triggered; sensor snapshot shows 69.06 °C while cooling flow, current, speed, and vibration remain normal.

supporting_evidence.finding: Reported motor temperature exceeded 65 °C; sensor snapshot recorded 69.06 °C with normal ancillary parameters.
Triggered when motor temperature reaches 65 °C. Possible causes: insufficient cooling, excessive mechanical load, motor overheating, faulty temperature sensor.
Look for sudden unrealistic temperature jumps and compare temperature changes with current, cooling flow, and operating conditions.
On 2026-01-13, temperature sensor calibration completed; readings within calibration tolerance.
On 2026-01-06, cooling filter cleaned; flow restored to normal.

alternative_explanations: Insufficient cooling flow despite normal reading (possible sensor drift).
Excessive mechanical load causing internal motor heating without current increase.
Actual motor overheating due to internal fault not reflected in current or vibration.
Communication outage causing stale temperature data.
missing_evidence: Independent temperature measurement (e.g., external thermocouple) to confirm sensor reading.
Detailed motor thermal imaging or infrared inspection.
Pressure or flow verification from a secondary flow sensor.
Controller log entries surrounding the alarm for possible software glitches.
recommended_checks: Cross‑check motor temperature with an independent probe.
Inspect motor windings and bearings for signs of overheating.
Verify cooling system pressure and flow with a calibrated secondary sensor.
Review controller firmware logs for any communication errors at 14:12.
Perform a functional test of the temperature sensor after the next scheduled maintenance.

note: Structured evidence checks passed. Narrative and causal claims are not fully verified.
